text_block_list.text:
It's Нарита Брайан! Нарита Брайан has taken
first place!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

...You really are a beast. Just how strong
are ya
gonna get?
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Afraid, are you?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: ...Don't be stupid.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
I'm just lookin' forward to the day I take
you
down.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm not just going to sit around
waiting for
you. I have to keep moving
forward.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Perfect. Wait for me as you move
forward, then.
I'll catch up soon enough.
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Heh.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Both of them silently extend a hand
toward the
other.

They shake hands firmly, surrounded by

magnificent applause.
The next day, in front of the hospital...
...What?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Your mother didn't tell you? Well,
you
see... Your sister is...
text_block_list.name: Physical Therapist

text_block_list.text: Hey, Sis!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Oh, Brian! Why are you so out of
breath?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Is it true?! Mom said your leg is better!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Ah, yes. I've made a full recovery.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I can move my leg freely and have finally
been
discharged from the hospital.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It took quite a long time, I know, but it
seems like
you and I can finally race.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Yeah...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hm... Haha...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: What's so funny?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You know back when you invited me to
Tracen
Academy?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
What would you have done if I told you I
wouldn't
go?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Would you still have gone forward and
continued
running in the Twinkle Series?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... This is all completely
hypothetical, of
course...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But I think I'd have continued running.
I'd have
kept polishing myself until I was
able give you the
race you've always
been looking for.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I see... Tough as always.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Hey, Sis...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: My next race is the Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text: Yes, I know. I'll meet you there.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
